notes: The colophon names no scribe, patron or king. The text is the Skandapurāṇa, Brahmottarakhaṇḍa, adhyāya 22. The year 1899 is read as VS (the 'sāla' and 'roja' wording is Nepali/Persian-influenced) and gives about 1842 CE. The catalogue field says 'SAM 1899', which does not name an era. Reading 'saṃvat 1899' as NS would give about 2779 CE, which is impossible, so VS is the only workable reading.
